title: Number Operating (Easy Version)
statement: The task sums f(n) over n in [l, r] mod 998244353, where f(n) is the fewest operations reaching n from 0 by adding 2^k (k = current add streak) or subtracting 1. With r up to 10^18 but total range length at most 2·10^5, each n is evaluated alone. A run of k adds gives 2^k − 1, so f(n) greedily splits floor(n/2) into Mersenne numbers, with an overshoot-then-decrement option.
